44707.summary: The class explores the concept of atonement, focusing on its usage in the Old Testament and its significance in the New Testament. It examines the first demonstration of atonement in Genesis 3, where Adam and Eve receive coats of skins after their sin, and discusses the sacrificial system in Leviticus as a pattern of things in the heavens.

44708.summary: The class discusses the concept of atonement through the lens of the Epistle to the Hebrews, emphasizing Jesus Christ's role as a high priest who offered himself for his own sins and those of the people, highlighting the necessity of his sacrifice and the reality of human sinfulness.
